components.name: Gold CTA

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Header CTA
components.description: Compact gold CTA in the fixed frosted header.

components.name: Channel Row
components.description: Signature buoy marker row — modality choice on the water field.
components.css: .ds-channel-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr auto; gap: 0.9rem; align-items: center; text-align: left; padding: 0.95rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(232, 244, 248, 0.35); background: rgba(11, 58, 74, 0.38); color: #E8F4F8; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-channel-row:hover, .ds-channel-row:focus-visible { background: rgba(11, 58, 74, 0.58); border-color: #F4C95F; transform: translateX(4px); outline: none; } .ds-channel-buoy { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #F4C95F; justify-self: center; animation: ds-buoy-bob 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-channel-row-text strong { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-channel-row-num { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0.55; } @keyframes ds-buoy-bob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-channel-row, .ds-channel-buoy { animation: none; transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The interface is an empty navigation channel toward WhatsApp: a full-bleed water field, one condensed headline, one short line of support, one gold CTA, and three buoy rows that mark modalities. Depth comes from the sky-to-abyss gradient and translucent ink panels, not from cards, shadows, or marketing sections.

Personality is coastal and operational — clear, 1-to-1, Uruguay Spanish — never decorative school brochure. Density is sparse: every element earns its place by helping the visitor assemble a consultation. Confirmed visual rejections: inset hero cards, eyebrows/kickers, pill clusters, multi-section marketing scroll, and soft Material corner radii.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport water gradient as the primary atmosphere (#9FD0E0 → #0B3A4A)
Buoy gold (#F4C95F) reserved for CTAs, focus, and row hover borders
Square geometry everywhere (0px radius); circular only for the buoy marker glyph
Barlow Condensed uppercase for brand signals; IBM Plex Sans for body and proof
Modality list as flat marker rows, not cards

rules.name: The Buoy Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only as action or focus signal — CTAs, :focus-visible, progress is-on, and row hover borders. Do not wash large surfaces in gold.

rules.name: The Water Field Rule
rules.body: The first composition is the gradient field itself. Do not replace it with a flat single-color page or an inset media card.

rules.name: The Condensed Signal Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Barlow Condensed is for brand verbs and modality markers. Body copy stays sentence-case IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The One Headline Rule
rules.body: The first viewport carries one display line. Do not stack competing display blocks or decorative eyebrows above it.

rules.name: The Empty Channel Rule
rules.body: The landing job is assemble → WhatsApp. Do not add gallery, FAQ, process, marquee, or long-form school sections to the primary channel.

rules.name: The Flat Marker Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat. Hover deepens the ink wash and shifts the row — it does not lift with shadow.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: UI chrome is square. Do not reintroduce Material soft corners or pill CTAs.

dos: Do keep the first viewport as one channel: brand, one headline, one sub, one gold CTA, three buoy rows.
Do use buoy gold only for action and focus signals.
Do set all chrome radii to 0px; keep the buoy glyph circular.
Do set modality choices as flat marker rows with hairline borders on the water field.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by removing bob and row transitions.
donts: Don't introduce eyebrows, kickers, or pill clusters above the headline.
Don't place inset hero media cards, rounded media tiles, or floating image blocks on the channel.
Don't use drop shadows to fake elevation.
Don't expand the landing into multi-section brochure content (gallery, FAQ, process, marquee).
Don't soften Material corners or restyle CTAs as rounded pills.
